observation: The deep-api gate couples current-day external copper-price availability to overall release-gate completion, so an unrelated code stage can be blocked when the live source is unavailable.
currentDecision: No gate was weakened, skipped, mocked, or supplied with stale copper data during N4.2A-R2G.
futureDesignDirection: Design separate hermetic API/contract correctness and external freshness/availability acceptance signals in a dedicated test-infrastructure ticket.
